message.content: {"question": "A ballistic pendulum is a device used to calculate the muzzle velocities of bullets. It is a pendulum constructed by hanging a wooden block with a very high mass at the end of a rope with length L. When a bullet with mass m traveling at speed v embeds itself into the wooden block with mass M, the (bullet + block) system rises by height h. Calculate the speed of the bullet when: m = 50g, M = 5kg, L = 2m, h = 80cm", "options": {"A": "v = 4000m/s", "B": "v = 4m/s", "C": "v = 40m/s", "D": "v = 400m/s"}, "correct": null}
